summary: Batch 2 meets the request, the signed-off design and the plan. The Run is registered in step 2b before any docker.from_env or Sandbox call, and a missing token, an unreachable backend, a 401 or a missing project aborts with one line and no container. A single outer except BaseException makes exactly one best-effort failed PATCH, after the inner teardown finally, and re-raises the original exception unchanged. Tests cover 14 stages plus Abort at the code prompt, and a raising or warning mark leaves the error line identical to baseline. On the backend, PATCH to failed or awaiting_review is a conditional filter(status__in={running}).update inside transaction.atomic with transient retry. Refusals are 409 and leave the row unchanged. A 20-iteration concurrency test passes. The non-gated PATCH saves update_fields only. A duplicate run_id is a 400 with an identical body in both the sequential and the real-IntegrityError race paths. The migration matches the design's pinned body (makemigrations --check is clean). Completion is an explicit PATCH after the last screenshot (D3, signed off). The dashboard failed pill (gray, distinct from the slate fallback) and items 6(a)-(d) are in. Nothing is staged, rules.py is untouched, and sandbox.py only has the earlier stdout_bytes edit. No assertion was weakened beyond the approved missing-token rewrite. This review re-ran backend 326 passed (replica set), the CLI non-Docker files 267 passed, frontend 60 passed, 6(c) PASSED, and the sibling Docker test FAILED. Only NITs remain.

findings.title: Run-id guard message says 'register' for completion and failed-mark paths
findings.fix: Make _guard_run_id's message neutral (e.g. f"Invalid run id {run_id!r}: {exc}"), or pass the action verb in from create_run/complete_run/mark_run_failed.

findings.title: Stale 'other four statuses' in DecisionControls doc comment
findings.fix: Change 'the other four statuses' to 'the other five statuses', matching the two comments already updated in this file.

findings.title: Docker-gated CLI suite has one pre-existing failure and one hang that the final report must name
findings.fix: In the final report, give the CLI full-suite result as N passed / 1 failed (test_exec_interactive_really_delivers_stdin_to_a_container_process: RECEIVED:[***], the same send_line-arms-redaction cause as 6(c)) / 1 not run (test_a_hanging_signin_hits_the_read_timeout_instead_of_blocking_forever at :1552, which hangs in docker-py poll(), a sandbox.py product bug). Optionally, with the user's agreement on scope, apply the 6(c) raw-socket write to the first test.

findings.title: Design acceptance 12 says 'slate style' but section 4.6 pins gray
findings.fix: In the final report, note that the implementation follows section 4.6 and the user's 'neutral/grey' (bg-gray-100, asserted not bg-slate-100), and that slate would collide with UNKNOWN_STATUS_STYLE. Optionally correct acceptance 12's wording.
